mckinsey-106150.text:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, USG Analytics (Backend & AI) within USG Analytics, you will play a critical role in delivering innovative technology solutions that transform how U.S. government organizations operate.
At USG Analytics, we combine engineering rigor, product thinking, and cutting-edge AI to enable meaningful impact for our clients. In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and deploying agentic and generative AI-powered solutions, modern workflow tools, and scalable applications within secure government environments. This is a hands-on role where you will thrive on building and shipping real systems that address complex and meaningful challenges.
You will design and implement agentic AI systems and generative AI-enabled workflows that drive efficiency and innovation for government clients. Your work will involve developing scalable, secure applications that integrate seamlessly across enterprise systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance and compliance. Collaborating closely with designers and product managers, you will translate user needs into functional, impactful software solutions. Additionally, you will work directly with government stakeholders and client service teams, ensuring that the solutions you deliver align with their unique requirements and objectives.
In this role, you will also drive innovation while maintaining operational excellence. You will build and deploy AI-enabled applications across cloud environments, implementing advanced systems such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent orchestration frameworks, tool-calling architectures, and secure API integrations. Your responsibilities will include developing backend services, data pipelines, and application logic, while also contributing to frontend or workflow-layer development as needed.
As part of your solution engineering responsibilities, you will architect modular, reusable, and platform-flexible solutions that can adapt to evolving client needs. You will evaluate AI models and platforms to ensure they meet performance, security, and operational requirements, while also ensuring observability, monitoring, and reliability of deployed systems.
Your role will also involve direct client engagement, where you will translate complex client challenges into actionable technical implementation plans. You will collaborate closely with client technical teams to ensure seamless integration and adoption of new AI-enabled workflows. Additionally, you will provide training and support to end users, empowering them to fully leverage the capabilities of the solutions you deliver.
Continuous innovation will be a key aspect of your work. You will prototype rapidly to test new agentic and generative AI capabilities, contributing to internal libraries, accelerators, and reusable components that enhance the efficiency and scalability of our solutions. Staying current on advances in AI systems and workflow technologies will be essential, enabling you to bring the latest innovations to your work and deliver cutting-edge solutions to our clients.
Through your efforts, you will help USG Analytics deliver transformative technology solutions that enable U.S. government organizations to operate more effectively, efficiently, and securely. Your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on addressing some of the most pressing challenges faced by government clients today.
US Citizenship required
5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML, or full-stack development
Experience deploying applications in cloud-native environments
Experience building within complex, highly regulated environments preferred but not required
Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Python, Java, TypeScript)
Experience building or integrating, LLM-based systems, Agentic frameworks (e.g., orchestration layers, tool use, memory management), RAG pipelines and vector databases
Familiarity with APIs, microservices, and modern DevOps practices
Understanding of secure system design and compliance considerations
Systems thinker who can connect user needs to architecture

As an OptimusAI Senior Data Science Analyst, you will help leading companies across the Energy and Materials sector unlock their full productivity potential using AI.
Collaborating in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3-6 experts, you will use your creativity and analytics expertise to enhance client performance in areas such as energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You will be working side-by-side with the client’s process engineers and analytics specialists and will be communicating your work to executive audiences.
Internally, you will collaborate with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms to address current and future client needs. You will help codify best practices, radiate our impact in/externally and shape the product roadmap.
Along the way, you will benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, while working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. You will experience unparalleled career growth with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. You can seize the opportunity to travel to client sites, locally and around the world.
Please submit a cover letter detailing why you are the perfect fit for our team and how you can contribute to our mission!
You will be based in our Houston or Denver office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution (OptimusAI), which sits at the intersection of three practices.
Global Energy and Materials advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.
QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, is the AI arm of our firm which helps clients transform faster, innovate smart, and anticipate the future.
Finally, the Operations Practice which assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing operational strategies, initiatives, and solutions for their most critical problems, connecting boardroom strategies to the shop floor operators.
At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists and engineers, focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics.
We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in the plant control room, we assess and optimize process control systems, and we unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.
OptimusAI supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying the approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You will design, build, and deploy ML/AI solutions across priority provider use cases; clinical decision support, care management, revenue cycle optimization, patient access, and agentic workforce tools; with clear outcome accountability.
Healthcare is one of the most consequential domains in which AI can create real, durable impact; and it is also one of the most complex. Provider organizations are sitting on enormous clinical and operational data assets, but turning those assets into deployed, trusted AI systems at scale requires the kind of rigorous, multi-disciplinary approach that McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs are uniquely positioned to deliver.
You will work on AI systems that directly influence how care is delivered, how clinicians spend their time, how patients flow through the system, and how resources are allocated. The models you build are not proofs-of-concept; they are production systems used by some of the largest health systems in the country. That combination of technical rigor, healthcare domain depth, and real-world deployment scale is rare, and it is what makes your work exceptional.
You will be solving the hardest data and AI challenges in healthcare with direct client exposure and measurable clinical and operational results.
You will work with rich, multi-modal clinical datasets (EHR/EMR, claims, clinical notes, imaging, device feeds) using advanced NLP, generative AI, and predictive modeling to surface insights that improve care delivery.
You will leverage and extend QuantumBlack Labs' latest generative AI and agentic frameworks to build autonomous clinical workflows; from AI-assisted documentation to intelligent care-management agents that act on behalf of clinicians.
You will write optimized, production-ready code; develop reusable ML pipelines and model assets that can scale across multiple health systems in the portfolio.
You will partner with QuantumBlack Labs data scientists, ML engineers, and product managers, as well as Social, Healthcare, and Private Entities (SHaPE) clinicians and transformation consultants, to translate complex healthcare requirements into production AI systems.
You will contribute to McKinsey's growing body of healthcare AI knowledge; writing papers, presenting at industry conferences, and shaping internal capability-building programs.
You will design AI applications to operate safely and reliably in regulated healthcare environments, partnering with data engineers to ensure robust data pipelines, governance, lineage, and HIPAA compliance.
You will translate technical outputs into actionable recommendations for clinical and operational leaders, and present findings and implications to executive stakeholders at health systems.
You will rapidly prototype and iterate on statistical and machine learning models, using rigorous experimentation to validate clinical and business impact before scaling.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll deploy and scale EcliptOS — QuantumBlack's AI forward Operating System — a next-generation platform designed to connect strategy to execution through agentic systems.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure, bringing EcliptOS into real-world environments and ensuring it works at scale. You'll play a key role in how the platform is deployed, adopted, and operated, enabling organizations to translate complex AI strategies into practical, high-impact solutions.
You'll own the EcliptOS platform delivery lifecycle, bridging product engineering and client environments. Responsibilities include deploying and configuring production-grade systems across cloud and hybrid infrastructures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), validating performance and stability, and ensuring structured handovers for long-term success. Work often involves containerized and distributed systems, including Kubernetes-based environments, where reliability and operational stability are critical. You'll troubleshoot issues end-to-end and ensure EcliptOS is fully production-ready, while also contributing to deployment tooling, automation, and product feedback loops to improve platform reliability and delivery.
The impact of this work is tangible. You'll enable clients to run AI-driven workflows and manage intelligent systems within their existing technology ecosystems. Working closely with technical stakeholders, you'll ensure environment readiness, resolve deployment challenges, and guide adoption through practical best practices. Your experience from the field will also contribute to feedback loops between deployments and EcliptOS product development, supporting the continuous evolution of QuantumBlack's technology.
Based in one of our North America offices, you'll work closely with engineers, product teams, and technical experts across QuantumBlack's global community. Beyond EcliptOS deployments, you'll collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, designers, and technologists on interdisciplinary initiatives, contributing to a broader ecosystem of AI innovation. Together, you'll help operationalize advanced AI systems across industries, driving successful delivery, validation, and adoption in client environments. You'll also contribute to team knowledge-sharing — documenting patterns, refining delivery practices, and supporting colleagues across engagements.
At QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, you'll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You'll develop a sought-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, work across industries, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to unlock the transformative potential of AI, while advancing as a technologist and leader.
